title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 45
description: Ten questions on Genesis 45: Joseph makes himself known to his brothers and sends for his father.

questions.text: What did Joseph call out before he made himself known to his brothers?
questions.explanation: Joseph couldn't control himself and called out, "Cause everyone to go out from me!"

answers.text: "Bring me my silver cup at once!"
"Cause everyone to go out from me!"
"Bind these men and take them away!"

questions.text: What did Joseph ask his brothers right after saying "I am Joseph!"?
questions.explanation: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Does my father still live?"

questions.text: According to Joseph, why had God sent him to Egypt before his brothers?
questions.explanation: Joseph told them not to be grieved or angry with themselves, "for God sent me before you to preserve life."

answers.text: To learn the wisdom of Egypt

questions.text: How many more years of famine did Joseph say were still to come?
questions.explanation: Joseph said the famine had been in the land for two years, "and there are yet five years" with no plowing and no harvest.

questions.text: In which land did Joseph say his father would dwell, near to him?
questions.explanation: Joseph's message to his father was, "You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me."

questions.text: On whose neck did Joseph fall and weep?
questions.explanation: Joseph fell on his brother Benjamin's neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh command the brothers to take out of Egypt for their little ones and wives?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come."
Joseph gave Benjamin three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

answers.text: A silver cup and a gold chain about his neck
Three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing
Ten camels loaded with spices and myrrh
Twenty pieces of silver and a new tunic

questions.text: What did Joseph say to his brothers as he sent them away?
questions.explanation: As they departed, Joseph said to them, "See that you don't quarrel on the way."

answers.text: "See that you don't quarrel on the way."

questions.text: How did Jacob first react when his sons told him Joseph was still alive?
questions.explanation: When they told him Joseph was alive and ruler over all Egypt, his heart fainted, for he didn't believe them.

answers.text: His heart fainted, for he didn't believe them
He laughed and danced for joy
He tore his clothes in anger
He set out for Egypt that same night
